nodes.docs: One entry of `claude agents --json`, which lists the sessions agent view shows.
The working directory, `interactive` or `background`, and the start time in Unix milliseconds (one row for `cwd`, `kind`, `startedAt`)
Short ID, usable with `claude attach`, `claude logs`, and `claude stop` (Background sessions)
The working directory, `interactive` or `background`, and the start time in Unix milliseconds (one row for `cwd`, `kind`, `startedAt`)

`sessionId` is the full session UUID, usable with [`claude --resume`](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sessions). An interactive session's `name` is its [default display name](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sessions#name-your-sessions) until you name the session or accept a plan in it (one row for `sessionId`, `name`; When set)
Process ID and one of `busy`, `waiting`, or `idle` (one row for `pid`, `status`; While the process is alive)

`sessionId` is the full session UUID, usable with [`claude --resume`](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sessions). An interactive session's `name` is its [default display name](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sessions#name-your-sessions) until you name the session or accept a plan in it (one row for `sessionId`, `name`; When set)
The working directory, `interactive` or `background`, and the start time in Unix milliseconds (one row for `cwd`, `kind`, `startedAt`)

One of `working`, `blocked`, `done`, `failed`, or `stopped`. See [Read session state from a script](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-view#read-session-state-from-a-script) for what each value means (Background sessions)
Process ID and one of `busy`, `waiting`, or `idle` (one row for `pid`, `status`; While the process is alive)

What the session is blocked on: `permission prompt` for an approval, `input needed` for a question from Claude or an MCP server's input request, `sandbox request`, `worker request`, or `dialog open` (When `status` is `waiting`)
